latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of DomainForAgents skill:

- Search, register, and manage internet domains programmatically via DomainForAgents API
- Get AI-generated domain suggestions from project descriptions
- Manage DNS records and check domain availability, pricing, and balance
- Multiple payment methods supported (prepaid, credit card, USDC, Stripe link)
- No browser signup or CAPTCHA required; quick API key issuance
- Supports a wide range of global TLDs (not country-code)
